title: Rubio: US Troop Redeployments in Europe Not Aimed at Punishing NATO Allies Over Iran
detail: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio clarified that Washington's troop redeployments in Europe are not aimed at punishing allies for insufficient support over Iran — offering partial reassurance to NATO partners alarmed by recent US force posture shifts. The statement addresses concerns among European allies who feared the redeployments were retaliatory following disagreements over the Iran conflict response.

media.caption: Rubio clarifies US troop redeployments in Europe are not punitive toward NATO allies
